name: leap-aide shadcn (tier-2)
description: shadcn/ui skeleton with the DataLeap brand pinned: brand-green primary (#18A00D/#5AC750), six-color categorical chart scale, stock neutral oklch surfaces, Geist font. 60 components installed verbatim via `shadcn add --all`.

tokens.notes: Semantic CSS variables in :root (light) and .dark (dark). Radius scale derives from the single --radius base. Values are oklch.

components.notes: One file per component, stock shadcn source. Import alias: @/components/ui/<name>.
